New message in #sales:

mike: does anyone know the current MRR for Acme Corp?

input.text: @mike I can pull it—do you want current active-subscription MRR (USD) as of today, or last billed month? And which source should I use (Salesforce account MRR field or Stripe)? If you drop the Acme Corp account link, I’ll grab the number and post back. If it’s urgent, you can also check Salesforce → Accounts → Acme Corp → “MRR (Home Currency)”.

content.text: I replied in #sales asking Mike to confirm the definition and source for MRR and offered to pull it once he shares the Acme Corp account link.
